blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — EvoEnergi, an affiliate of the listed Lao family-led D&L Industries Inc., is maintaining a strong presence in the retail power market as it secures new contracts to power more schools, hospitals, and religious institutions. Citing data from the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) covering the past 13 months, the firm said it has clinched the top spot as retail aggregator by number of aggregated groups. READ: First residential aggregation groups join RCOA This year alone, EvoEnergi bagged retail electricity supply partnerships with academic institutions, medical facilities, and churches across the country.
